caption: The drawing depicts a circular, shallow dish or plate with a side profile view of the object below it. The interior of the dish is decorated with a central symmetrical floral motif, predominantly in shades of brown, beige, and orange, each color outlined and shaded to give a three-dimensional effect. At the base of the central motif, inside a stylized heart shape, are the numbers "1824" written in a grayish color. The floral design includes a central stem with trident-like petals at the top and broad, curling leaves or petals extending outward symmetrically from the sides. The rim of the plate is bordered with round, light-colored dots. The exterior side view of the dish, shown underneath the main depiction, reveals a reddish-brown color and a gently sloped shape. The two depictions are rendered on a cream or off-white background with a faintly outlined rectangle indicating the composition space. The drawing is signed in cursive at the bottom right corner.
title: Pa. German Plate
